title: Consulting Practice Leader
description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.

 **Responsibilities**

People Management

Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.

Model - Live our culture; Embody our values; Practice our leadership principles.

Coach - Define team objectives and outcomes; Enable success across boundaries; Help the team adapt and learn.

Care - Attract and retain great people; Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations; Invest in the growth of others.

Customer Focus

Creates a customer-centric culture within the practice that drives digital transformation and ensures customer satisfaction across the entire operating unit by maintaining stakeholder relationships, reviewing and acting on voice of customer (VoC) feedback (e.g., surveys, listening systems), sharing learnings across practices, alleviating customer blockers as a point of escalation, and sponsoring systemic improvements to the customer experience across workstreams. Holds accountability for portfolio, account, and financial management in presales and delivery. Owns highly strategic and complex customer relationships. Leads direct engagements with large, complex customers and serves as a delivery sponsor for a select number of assigned customers. Supports strategic relationships with key stakeholders in the customer portfolio, often as part of a steering committee, to ensure service delivery is on track and major issues are being anticipated, identified, and managed. Establishes accountabilities to drive customer outcomes and ensure internal stakeholders are in place.

Alleviates customer blockers as a point of escalation by working with direct reports and key stakeholders to manage customer escalations and resolve issues at the practice level. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams (e.g., Sales, Architects).

Develops and maintains highly complex business relationships through conversations and in-person customer engagements, leveraging in-depth knowledge of customer's business and industry. Ensures relationship plans are part of account strategic plans and acts as an executive sponsor to maintain senior-level relationships across their business. Communicates current view of delivery to customer executives on a regular cadence, as appropriate. Supports new, high-impact customer opportunities in partnership with Sales with highly significant or global impacts for Microsoft.

For assigned customers and for their team, supports guidance of customers/partners through relevant change initiatives and leverages core change-management methods and techniques. For assigned customers and for their team, supports management of changes (e.g., negotiations, change requests, amendments, customer expectations) while overseeing financial accountability and overall responsibility between Microsoft and the client.

Strategy

As needed, develops and executes a large, complex (e.g., global account, cross-territory impact) plan for their practice and assigned customers to achieve consumption metrics and revenue targets (e.g., delivered, billed, consumed) by supporting the team, collaborating with internal partners, and driving culture.

Establishes and drives rhythm of business (ROB) around consumption by managing financials (e.g., Enterprise Cloud Investment Funds [ECIFs], internal investments).

Oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all-up delivery of consulting engagements. Serves as a proven thought leader on the direction of the consulting offerings portfolio for a large, complex practice, leveraging insights from reports (e.g., efficiency, operations), internal team members, and across organizational boundaries. Develops and implements a strategic portfolio-wide plan to achieve targets by leading intentional delivery activities and leveraging intellectual property (IP) for reuse.

Promotes Industry Solution Delivery (ISD) consumption strategy with regional perspective by articulating ISD consumption strategy, goals, and mission to internal and external audiences, and aligning practice strategy with the customer and other internal organization objectives (e.g., Consulting Sales, Go-To-Market).

Supports sales activities (e.g., close planning, delivery sponsorship, strategy, management) to support the lifecycle of deals for a large practice, leveraging prior experience and expertise. As needed, negotiates, collaborates on, reviews, and contributes to deal approval processes, sometimes challenging deal construct to ensure Microsoft initiatives are incorporated appropriately. When appropriate, innovates and implements long-term, strategic plans, in partnership with Sales to create new opportunities and sustainable growth for customer accounts across the portfolio. Ensures delivery team alignment and holds delivery team accountable for delivering on sales strategy.

Collaborates on highly strategic (e.g., high profile) captures by ensuring a strategic capture plan, engaging the resources needed for pre-sales, and supporting the global pursuit team in winning large-contract deals.

Acts as an innovative agent of change by working within leadership communities to define and sponsor organizational change, driving consistent messaging and support to land organizational change initiatives within and across practices, and providing feedback on organization information/initiatives.

Delivery Excellence

Orchestrates a large cross-functional team to drive high-impact business growth, profitability, utilization, maturity, quality, etc., through delivery by developing a rhythm of business (ROB), fostering a culture of manager excellence, promoting teamwork and collaboration, recognizing and aligning team strengths to capability needs, and leveraging diverse perspectives to understand customers. Governs areas of fiscal responsibility, through delivery team, staying within budget while driving engagement profitability and risk management.

Ensures delivery excellence and maximizes efficiency of resources for a large practice by managing complex scopes and budgets, balancing funding and resources across workstreams, communicating resource needs (e.g., hiring, resource planning, capacity) with the business, collaborating to meet those needs, and leveraging in-depth resource-management experience and expertise.

Creates a problem solving climate across teams that resolves complex or high-impact delivery issues across lifecycle of deal (e.g., lead to order, order to cash, resourcing, pricing, invoicing, proof of execution) through cross-cultural collaboration and partnerships (e.g., Selling partners) to ensure sustained delivery quality. Interfaces at high levels in organization (e.g., executives) to resolve critical issues (e.g., subsidiary, worldwide issues).

Applies governance controls to mitigate and manage risks and ensure policy compliance in delivery and sales. Models and holds team accountable for execution and adherence to Microsoft Consulting processes (e.g., Enterprise Consulting Authorization Policy, Delivery excellence processes/procedures, time tracking/approvals). Documents and executes plans to mitigate identified risks for challenged deliveries.

Drives action plans and continuous improvement plans to increase maturity of organization and delivery quality using feedback from others and industry standards. Influences others to secure resources for deliveries, and holds teams accountable for maintaining obligations to customer contracts and ensuring delivery services across the services lifecycle. Attends steering committee meetings, as needed, with strategic customers to remove blockers and ensure delivery success.

Practice Building

Builds organizational capability by leveraging in-depth industry knowledge to anticipate and plan for future capability needs, investing in key professional development opportunities for their team members, conducting succession planning, defining career development plans, and providing coaching to develop process proficiency, leadership, and technical skills. Adheres to the Model, Coach, Care framework and Leadership Principles to attract, develop, and retain talent, deliver results through teamwork as One Microsoft, role model Microsoft values, and commit to performance management across their practice.

Drives margin targets by leading a forecasting rhythm (e.g., monthly business rhythms) for delivered revenue (e.g., Industry Solutions Delivery, key dependencies to Delivery Value), consumption, and utilization to predict business results for a large, complex geographic area. Drives internal revenue targets through team by providing guidance and monitoring progress. Performs analyses and identifies insights that support key-operating mechanisms (e.g., capacity planning, hiring, delivery excellence), and recommends changes to improve outcomes.

Drives clear expectations with all team members around intellectual property (IP) reuse in alignment with organization goals (e.g., proactive delivery/efficiency targets, projects/pre-sales), while actively assessing existing reuse behaviors and coaching team members to drive an increase in reuse behaviors. Delivers proactive change-management plans to customers leading business transformation and evolution through IP reuse and worldwide offerings/managed intellectual property (MIP). Identifies and implements innovative new opportunities for IP reuse.

Other

Embody our culture and values

 **Qualifications**

Required/Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field AND 12+ years relevant work experience

OR equivalent experience.

8+ years team leadership or people management experience either with or without direct reports.

Additional or Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field AND 15+ years relevant work experience

OR equivalent experience.

10+ years people management experience.

15+ years experience in sales/selling.

8+ years project/portfolio management experience.

4+ years account management experience.

title: Student Visa Officer
description:
Study Visa Officer

Department: Visas  
Designation: Study Visa Officer  
Company: Career Bridge Consultants Pvt. Ltd.  
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Study Visa Officer to manage end-to-end student visa application processes for international education destinations.

The candidate will be responsible for guiding students through visa requirements, assessing their eligibility, verifying academic and financial documents, preparing visa applications, coordinating with universities and relevant authorities, and ensuring accurate and timely application submissions.

The ideal candidate should possess strong knowledge of international student visa procedures, financial documentation, academic requirements, and immigration guidelines, along with excellent communication and student counselling skills.

Roles & Responsibilities

1. Student Consultation & Visa Eligibility Assessment

* Understand students' academic backgrounds, career goals, and overseas education plans.
* Assess student eligibility based on destination-specific visa requirements.
* Explain study visa procedures, eligibility criteria, financial requirements, and documentation.
* Guide students regarding suitable visa pathways based on their admission and course details.
* Explain visa conditions, work permissions, dependants' eligibility, and other relevant immigration rules.
* Coordinate with education counsellors regarding student profiles and admission status.

2. Academic & Financial Documentation

* Collect and verify academic certificates, transcripts, offer letters, and Confirmation of Enrolment (where applicable).
* Review English language proficiency results such as IELTS, PTE, TOEFL, or other accepted tests.
* Verify financial documents, bank statements, education loan documents, sponsorship letters, and income proofs.
* Review employment documents, experience letters, and other supporting records wherever required.
* Check consistency and accuracy across all documents.
* Identify missing documents and coordinate with students for completion.

3. Study Visa Application Processing

* Prepare and submit student visa applications through relevant government and immigration portals.
* Handle study visa applications for countries such as the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, and European destinations, depending on company requirements.
* Review application forms before submission to ensure accuracy.
* Guide students regarding visa application fees, health insurance, medical examinations, biometrics, and other requirements.
* Coordinate with universities, colleges, and relevant authorities whenever required.
* Track application progress and ensure submissions are completed within deadlines.

4. Statement of Purpose (SOP) & Supporting Documents

* Guide students regarding SOP requirements and structure.
* Assist in reviewing the student's academic background, course selection, career objectives, and study plans.
* Check the consistency of information provided in the SOP and supporting documents.
* Guide students regarding Genuine Student (GS) requirements or equivalent requirements applicable to their destination.
* Ensure that all statements are truthful and supported by appropriate documentation.
* Coordinate for additional explanations or supporting documents wherever necessary.

5. Financial Assessment & Visa Compliance

* Evaluate financial documentation according to destination-specific requirements.
* Check tuition fee payments, living expense funds, sponsorship details, and financial capacity.
* Ensure students understand the financial and immigration requirements.
* Keep updated with changes in immigration policies, visa rules, and embassy guidelines.
* Identify potential application risks and recommend corrective steps.
* Maintain strict compliance with immigration regulations and ethical processing standards.

6. Student Coordination & Follow-ups

* Maintain regular communication with students and parents through calls, WhatsApp, and emails.
* Follow up for pending documents, payments, medicals, biometrics, and other formalities.
* Provide regular updates regarding application status.
* Coordinate with the admissions, sales, and counselling teams.
* Address student queries professionally and ensure a smooth application experience.

7. Post-Submission & Visa Outcome Management

* Monitor applications until the final visa decision.
* Communicate visa approvals or refusals to students.
* Guide students regarding visa conditions, travel requirements, and pre-departure formalities.
* Assist with refusal analysis and possible reapplication guidance, where appropriate.
* Maintain records of approved, refused, pending, and withdrawn applications.

8. Reporting & Case Management

* Maintain daily and weekly student visa processing reports.
* Update CRM, student tracking sheets, and internal databases.
* Maintain individual student case files and documentation records.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth case handovers.
* Ensure timely completion of assigned cases and follow-ups.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong knowledge of international study visa procedures.
* Understanding of country-specific immigration requirements.
* Knowledge of academic and financial documentation.
* Understanding of SOP and Genuine Student requirements.
* Excellent student counselling and client-handling skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Good knowledge of MS Office, Excel, CRM, and online application portals.
* Strong analytical and documentation verification skills.
* Ability to manage multiple student applications.
* Excellent follow-up, coordination, and time-management skills.
* Ability to work towards application processing and closure targets.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of student visa cases handled.
* Number of applications successfully submitted.
* Documentation accuracy and verification quality.
* Timely application processing and submissions.
* Student follow-up and query resolution.
* Number of pending cases and successful case closures.
* Student satisfaction and service quality.
* Compliance with country-specific immigration guidelines.
* Daily and weekly reporting accuracy.
* Coordination with the admissions and counselling teams.

title: ETP Design & Project Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced ETP Design & Project Engineer to lead the end-to-end design, engineering, execution, installation and commissioning of Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) projects on a turnkey basis.

The candidate will be responsible for developing technically sound and commercially viable treatment solutions, preparing engineering designs and drawings, coordinating procurement and site execution, supervising installation and ensuring successful commissioning and project handover.

The role requires strong technical expertise in wastewater treatment processes, hands-on project execution capabilities and the ability to independently manage turnkey projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Technical Assessment & Process Design**

* Understand client requirements, wastewater characteristics, inlet water quality and treated-water discharge/reuse requirements.
* Conduct site assessments and evaluate wastewater generation, flow rates and treatment requirements.
* Develop appropriate ETP process designs based on wastewater characteristics and applicable standards.
* Prepare process flow diagrams (PFDs), process calculations, hydraulic designs and equipment sizing.
* Design treatment systems covering physical, chemical and biological treatment processes.
* Determine treatment stages, tank capacities, retention times, chemical dosing and sludge management requirements.
* Optimise plant design for performance, energy efficiency and project cost.

**2. Engineering & Technical Documentation**

* Prepare process flow diagrams, piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), general arrangement (GA) drawings and equipment layouts.
* Prepare technical specifications and equipment datasheets.
* Identify and finalise pumps, blowers, agitators, filters, clarifiers, dosing systems, membranes and other treatment equipment.
* Prepare BOQs, material specifications and technical documentation.
* Coordinate with CAD/design teams and external engineering consultants wherever required.

**3. Turnkey Project Execution**

* Take ownership of ETP projects from design and engineering through execution and commissioning.
* Plan project schedules, resource requirements and execution milestones.
* Coordinate procurement, vendors, contractors and installation teams.
* Supervise civil, mechanical, electrical and instrumentation works.
* Ensure installation is carried out as per approved engineering drawings and specifications.
* Monitor project progress, quality, costs and timelines.
* Resolve technical challenges and ensure adherence to project specifications.

**4. Testing & Commissioning**

* Lead pre-commissioning, testing and commissioning activities.
* Conduct performance trials and ensure the plant achieves the designed treatment parameters.
* Troubleshoot process and equipment-related issues.
* Validate treated-water quality through laboratory testing.
* Prepare commissioning reports, operating manuals and technical handover documents.
* Train client teams on plant operation and maintenance.

**5. Client & Project Coordination**

* Act as the technical point of contact for clients and consultants.
* Participate in technical discussions, site meetings and project reviews.
* Coordinate with internal sales, procurement, design and execution teams.
* Provide technical inputs for proposals, tender submissions and project costing.

Argano is a digital consultancy that specializes in high-performance business operations, digital transformation, and AI-driven solutions. We help enterprise and mid-market organizations modernize their core systems, streamline supply chains, and improve financial, data, and workforce operations to exceed customer expectations and fuel commercial growth.

Argano’s Pigment Practice is redefining business planning consulting by combining deep domain expertise with cutting-edge technology. As a Solution Architect, you are the engine of our delivery — you design and build the Pigment solutions that transform how our clients plan, forecast, and make decisions. You work within our pod model alongside experienced Pod Leads, Delivery Managers, and Consultants.

**The Role**

As a Solution Architect, you will be responsible for designing and implementing Pigment solutions for mid-market and enterprise clients. You will work closely with clients to gather requirements, design models, build solutions, and support go-live. You will be mentored by senior architects while progressively taking on more complex design challenges and client leadership responsibilities. This roles will be based in Mexico or Colombia.

* Participate in solution design reviews and contribute to architecture decisions

* Mentor and guide Consultants on technical development and Pigment best practices
* Support pre-sales with technical input for proposals and effort estimation
* Contribute to client training and change management activities

* Strong technical skills in model design, calculation logic, and data integration
* Understanding of financial and operational planning processes (budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, scenario planning)
* Client-facing communication skills with the ability to lead workshops and present to business stakeholders
* Experience in consulting or professional services environment preferred
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams and deliver quality output under deadline pressure
* Experience with data transformation tools, SQL, APIs, or ETL processes a plus
* Industry experience in Life Sciences, CPG, or Technology a plus

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a technically strong planning consultant who wants to work at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You have built models in at least one EPM platform and understand the underlying planning processes. You are a self-starter who can run workstreams independently while collaborating effectively within a team. You are hungry to learn Pigment if you don’t already know it, and you see this as a career-defining opportunity to grow with a practice from early stage to market leader.

**How You Embody Our Guiding Principles**

* **Become an Expert:** You pursue mastery of Pigment and planning best practices
* **Stay Curious:** You are always learning, always asking “why” and “what if”
* **Be a Team Player:** You succeed as a pod, not as an individual
* **Own Your Growth:** You seek feedback and take on stretch assignments

We steward enterprises through ever-evolving markets, empowering them with transformative strategies and technologies to exceed customer expectations, unlock commercial innovation, and drive optimal efficiency and growth.

**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

Crowe’s Microsoft Consulting Practice is hiring an **Agentic Business Process Analyst** to help clients rethink how work gets done in the AI era. This is not a traditional business analyst role focused only on documenting requirements, writing user stories, or mapping current-state processes. This role is for someone who can diagnose business problems, understand root causes, redesign processes, and identify where AI agents, automation, data, and human judgment should come together.

The ideal candidate is deeply functional, process-oriented, and comfortable enough with technology to work side by side with engineers, architects, and client IT teams. This person should be able to bridge business and technology, helping clients move from legacy workflows to intelligent, agent-enabled processes.

This role also has an internal transformation mandate. The person will help upskill Crowe Consulting teams that may be used to traditional ERP, CRM, or business application delivery. They will help consultants develop a more modern mindset: start with problems, then processes, then technology.

**What you will do**

* Lead discovery sessions with clients to understand business goals, pain points, process breakdowns, data issues, user needs, controls, and operating constraints.
* Map end-to-end business processes, including inputs, outputs, roles, systems, decisions, handoffs, exceptions, controls, and performance measures.
* Diagnose root causes across people, process, data, and technology before recommending solutions.
* Identify opportunities for AI assistance, agentic augmentation, workflow orchestration, automation, knowledge retrieval, decision support, and process improvement.
* Partner with technical architects and engineers to translate process opportunities into solution designs, prototypes, functional specifications, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.
* Define business value measures for agentic solutions, such as time saved, cycle time reduction, first-time-right rate, SLA performance, adoption, override rate, CSAT, cost per transaction, revenue lift, and compliance improvement.
* Help clients decide where humans should stay in control, where AI should assist, and where agents can safely orchestrate or automate work.
* Support workshops, demos, process redesign sessions, executive presentations, and change management conversations.
* Create reusable playbooks, templates, process models, and training materials to help Crowe teams adopt an agentic business analysis approach.
* Coach Crowe consultants on how to move beyond legacy requirements gathering into diagnostic, value-led, AI-enabled transformation work.

**What success looks like**

* You can walk into a messy client process and make sense of it quickly.
* You can separate symptoms from root causes.
* You know when the right answer is process redesign, data cleanup, integration, training, governance, automation, or AI.
* You can help clients and internal teams understand what agents should do, what humans should do, and how to measure whether the new process is better.
* You make technical teams sharper by giving them better process context, and you make business teams more confident by helping them understand what technology can realistically do.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 6+ years as a Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, or Process Consultant.
* Strong business process mapping and redesign experience.
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and/or Power Platform implementations.
* Ability to facilitate client workshops and engage executive stakeholders.
* Exposure to AI, automation, or agentic transformation initiatives.
* Experience partnering with technical teams to deliver business solutions.
* Consulting or professional services background.
* Leadership or mentoring experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, Customer Insights, Project Operations, Finance, or Supply Chain.
* Experience with Power Platform, Copilot Studio, process mining, business process catalogs, customer journey mapping, service design, or operating model transformation.
* Experience identifying AI use cases, automation candidates, decision support opportunities, or agentic process patterns.
* Experience in consulting or professional services.
* Exposure to responsible AI, governance, risk, compliance, controls, or regulated industry environments.
